purpose: The one place the Arabic fold is specified. Three implementations must agree with it: ExclusionVocabulary.foldArabic in Dart, foldArabic in supabase/functions/discover/parse.ts, and public.fold_arabic in SQL. Each asserts against this file in its own suite; the SQL assertions are GENERATED from it by scripts/generate-folding-cases.py, so the third one cannot be updated by hand while the others move.
why: On 2026-08-07 the three folds disagreed on seventeen whitespace codepoints, because Postgres' [[:space:]] under COLLATE "C" is ASCII-only while Dart's and JavaScript's are Unicode-aware. A no-break space inside عين الجمل folded in two of them and not the third, so walnut escaped a nut exclusion. Both reviewers found it by writing throwaway differential harnesses and then deleting them. This file is that harness, kept.
note: `folded` is what all three must return. A case whose input is already folded is not filler — it pins that the fold does NOT change it, which is the half that stops somebody widening a rule until two different foods collapse into one.
